notes:
{建築|けんちく} covers both the field of architecture (design and planning of buildings) and the act of constructing buildings. It functions as a noun and a する verb.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: [noun]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{建築|けんちく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{建築|けんちく}{家|か}→建築家：06082_kenchikuka⟧: architect
- ⟦{建築|けんちく}{物|ぶつ}→建築物：21292_kenchikubutsu⟧: building, structure
- ⟦{建築|けんちく}{設計|せっけい}→建築設計：26305_kenchikusekkei⟧: architectural design
- {建築|けんちく}⟦{基準|きじゅん}→基準：00228_kijun⟧⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧: building standards law
- {建築|けんちく}⟦{資材|しざい}→資材：19470_shizai⟧: building materials

CONTRAST WITH ⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧:
{建築|けんちく} focuses on buildings and their design. ⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧ is broader and includes roads, bridges, dams, and other infrastructure. A ⟦{建築|けんちく}{家|か}→建築家：06082_kenchikuka⟧ designs buildings; a ⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧ may build anything.

VERB USAGE:
{建築|けんちく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ means to construct (a building). Often used in formal or technical contexts.
